errors.text_span: The chart illustrates negative log probabilities for “Per-specialty terms” across six medical specialties, showing how a model labeled “Mistral v0.2-Base” and versions fine-tuned on different specialties score terms from each specialty. The horizontal axis contains the category groups (Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, Pediatrics) ordered left to right as listed, and is labeled “Per-specialty terms.” The vertical axis is the value axis labeled “Negative log probability,” shown on a linear scale with tick marks from approximately −27 up to −22 in increments of 1. Each specialty group contains a cluster of seven vertical bars arranged side-by-side: one light blue bar for “Mistral v0.2-Base,” followed by six bars for “Fine-tuned on” specialties (Cardio in a very light beige, Gastro in a light tan, Infect in a light orange, Neuro in a medium orange, Obstetrics in a darker orange, and Pediatrics in the darkest brown). For Cardio terms, the bars range from about −25.7 to −26.7, with the blue base bar near −26.7 and the darkest brown Pediatrics fine-tuned bar near −26.1 while several other fine-tuned bars sit around roughly −25.7 to −25.9. For Gastro terms, values cluster around roughly −23.9 to −24.8, with the blue base bar near −24.8 and fine-tuned bars mostly near about −23.9 to −24.2 (the darkest brown around −24.2). For Infect terms, the blue base bar is around −23.7, while the fine-tuned bars are near roughly −23.0 to −23.3, with the darkest brown around −23.3. For Neuro terms, the blue base bar is around −25.4 and the fine-tuned bars are approximately −24.2 to −24.7, with the darkest brown near −24.7. For Obstetrics terms, the blue base bar is around −24.7 and the fine-tuned bars fall around roughly −23.8 to −24.1, with the darkest brown near −24.1. For Pediatrics terms, the blue base bar is around −24.7 and the fine-tuned bars are around roughly −23.4 to −24.0, with the darkest brown near −24.0.
